prompt:
Create a 3x1 sprite sheet for a modern 16-bit-style pixel-art RPG: one MONSTER in three battle poses.

Image 1 is a LAYOUT GUIDE: three cells on white. In each cell the light-grey box shows where the monster stands and how big it is, the grey line is the ground, and the arrow shows the facing: the monster faces RIGHT, toward the heroes. Draw the SAME monster once in every cell, filling its box. Never draw the grey box, line or arrow.

Image 2 is the HOUSE STYLE: an approved hero sprite sheet from this same game. Match its sprite-pixel size, black outlines, flat shading with 2-3 tones per colour and level of detail exactly, but do NOT copy the hero; it is a different character.

Image 3 is an APPROVED MONSTER sheet from this same game (a DIFFERENT monster, idle | attack | hurt): match its sprite-pixel size, rendering, shading, outline weight and level of detail, and how much the poses move. Do NOT copy that monster's body, colours or equipment.

Render as true pixel art: the monster about 56-72 pixels tall in sprite pixels, every sprite pixel a hard-edged square, no anti-aliasing, no gradients.

Monster: a tiger-headed sorcerer standing upright in rich long red robes with gold embroidery and a gold sash, a tiger head with amber eyes and a white ruff, hands with the palms turned the wrong way and long curved claws, gold rings; centred in its own cell with empty space on both sides. Keep every detail identical in every cell. FACE: its tiger face with amber eyes and a white ruff is readable.

Cells:
- left cell: idle, a ready battle stance facing right.
- middle cell: attack, leaning forward toward the heroes, both reversed clawed hands thrust out with the elbows bent, the jaws snarling, the hands well inside the middle cell, facing right.
- right cell: hurt, knocked back, the head thrown back, the robe sleeves flapping, the hands flung up, recoiling away from the heroes (leaning left), still facing right.

MOVEMENT: the attack and hurt cells are dramatic ACTION frames, not static stances. Use a clear diagonal line of action through the whole body, shift the weight onto one leg, lean the torso toward the heroes and reach the hands out with the elbows bent, so every reaching part stays well inside its own cell. Draw only the parts and clothing named in the description, the same in every cell: no cape, cloak or extra cloth, and no spell effects, smear or motion lines. Each of the three silhouettes must be clearly different. BODY: in every cell, standing on two feet, both feet on the ground line. No mist, smoke or ground effects.

One monster per cell and nothing else: no props on the ground, no effects outside the monster, no text.
Background: solid flat magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere, no floor, no shadows, no borders.
Avoid: two creatures in one cell, different creatures in different cells, background scenery, floor tiles, shadows on the ground, magic effects outside the cell, text, frame, border, grid lines, blurry, soft shading, gradient, 3d render, bare chest, a kilt, a weapon, a staff, a hood, a crown, a cape, stripes on the robe.
